text:
maria: Heads-up — we got a retroactive credit memo for ACME Corp for $28,450 tied to the June pricing experiment. Hit AR and the hosted-api revenue line. Need guidance for month-end entries and whether this is a revenue reduction or a deferral.
ajay: Thanks. Quick Q — was the credit applied as a refund (cash out) or as a credit memo against future invoices?
maria: Credit memo, not cash. It was issued after engineering flipped the experiment flag and it applied retroactively to past usage.
lisa: If it's a true reduction of consideration for services already delivered, under ASC 606 it reduces revenue recognized in the period of performance. If it's for future service credit, treat as deferred revenue (liability). Do we have the customer agreement language?
sam: From engineering: the experiment was an automated promo: "trial-boost" that reduced per-token charges and issued credit memos for the delta back to start of the month. No note about future credits.
ajay: Sounds like revenue reduction for June then. For close, we should reverse the portion of recognized revenue in June and adjust AR / credit memos.
maria: Can you propose exact journal entry we should post for June close and the correcting entry for July books? Need clear lines for auditors.
lisa: Proposed options below. Will need sign-off from maria for posting.
lisa: Option A — Retroactive revenue reduction (recommended):
```
Date: 2024-06-30 (recorded in June)
Dr. 4000 - Hosted API Revenue                   28,450
   Cr. 1200 - Accounts Receivable (credit memo) 28,450
Narrative: Reverse recognized revenue for ACME promo experiment; credit memo issued post-close.
```
lisa: Option B — If customer expects future credit (defer):
```
Date: 2024-06-30
Dr. 4000 - Hosted API Revenue                 28,450
   Cr. 2100 - Deferred Revenue (liability)    28,450
Narrative: Move amount to deferred revenue for future service fulfillment per customer agreement.
```
ajay: If we book Option A, we'll need to amend June revenue schedules and update ARR. Also need to tag the transaction with contract id ACME-2023-087 in the journal comment.
maria: Agreed. Let's do Option A unless legal says otherwise. I'll loop in legal if contract ambiguous. Sam — can you freeze further retroactive promos until we finish?
sam: Yep. I just pushed a hotfix to stop retroactive crediting. ops-bot: deploy succeeded: promo-freeze v1.2 deployed to prod :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks. ajay — can you prepare the JE and a short memo for the audit folder? Need it by EOD so bookkeeping can post before cut.
ajay: On it. Will include ACME contract reference, experiment id, and a reconciliation to the $28,450 credit memo.
lisa: One more thing — add a tag "revenue-adjustment-pricing-experiment" to the memo so Optimize/evals team can trace back model changes.
maria: Good call. Also need to confirm tax treatment — reach out to tax if this changes taxable revenue.
ajay: Will notify tax ops. I'll upload the memo and the proposed JE in the closing folder and ping here when posted.
maria: Thanks team. If legal flags it as future credit, we'll update entries and notify auditors. For now post Option A after ajay uploads the memo. :thumbsup:
